name: A Jumbled Puzzle of Glass Shards
source:
Two hikers meet up on a mountain trail, one taking a break from their monotonous life, and the other on a religious pilgrimage. It blossoms into love, that wilts in an accident.

The one left behinds winds up stumbling upon the Grim Reaper, and begs to be brought to a world where their beloved never died. Even though they can see her again, their mind is at unease.

[From [url=https://fizzsea.itch.io/a-jumbled-puzzle-of-glass-shards]itch.io[/url]]
